Package com.karandev.util.net.http

Class HttpConnection

java.lang.Object
com.karandev.util.net.http.HttpConnection
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public final class HttpConnection extends Object implements Closeable
Utility class for managing HTTP connections using HttpURLConnection.

Provides methods for opening, configuring, and interacting with HTTP connections, including header management, stream access, and connection properties.
